theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (f : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ L) → Euclid P) (S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)) (R₀ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)) (hd : Module.finrank ℝ L < n), 0 < Module.finrank ℝ L → Orthonormal ℝ f → (∀ i, f i ∈ L) → IsMinimizingIn S univ → R.Represents S → R₀.Represents S₀ → BoundaryVanishes S₀ → R₀.measure (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∫⁻ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), R₀.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]) → (∀ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n → Covector (Euclid P) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L), (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (v : Fin (n - Module.finrank ℝ L) → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append f v ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.add_sub_of_le hd.le).symm)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, S ω = ∫ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), currentEval S₀ (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t + y))) ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]) → IsMinimizingIn S₀ (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P))
